description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for the OpenCart admin extension related to 'total' functionality. It contains methods for displaying the total extension configuration page and saving its settings.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Total' extension in OpenCart's admin area, extending the base Controller class to handle configuration and saving of total-related settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the total extension configuration page, including loading language, setting the page title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the total extension settings via an AJAX request, including permission checks, updating configuration, and returning JSON response.
